summary: Quiet residential kerb with parked cars, but apartments sit 14-17 m away.

best_section.where: East kerb of Brisbane Street, south of the 50 m marker, opposite the bend

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 14-15 m away on the same side; houses 17-25 m beyond. Tree cover on the verge screens some of them.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, cars parked along the east kerb, so room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a busy road at the north end.
drivers.convention: Cars park here with 2P resident-permit signs; a van would blend in by day but signs limit daytime stays.

flags: Steep at north end: max grade 8.6%, but about 0.5% along best section
Gate 213 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the verge and kerb, mostly on the east side; shade through the afternoon.
